_comment_bind_host: IP/hostname to listen on; required only when bind_mode is custom (e.g. 192.168.1.10), otherwise leave null.
_comment_bind_mode: Transport choice: auto (Tailscale IP if detected + 127.0.0.1, else 127.0.0.1 only), localhost, tailscale, lan, or custom. Tailscale is optional.
_comment_allowed_workdirs: Optional array of absolute paths (e.g. ["/Users/you/Projects"]). When set and non-empty, POST /jobs and POST /sessions reject (403) any workdir outside these dirs. null/empty = no restriction. Start directory only: the agent still runs as your macOS user and can cd elsewhere inside a session.
_comment_default_model: Default model for runs. Cheap by default: Muse Ember (muse-ember-1.0) for routine work; set e.g. "muse-wonder-full-1.0" to default to the frontier model. A null value falls back to the shipped default, it does not mean "let Muse Code decide". Per-request `model` overrides it.
_comment_default_effort: Default reasoning effort tier (medium keeps routine work cheap; Muse Code's own default is high). Null falls back to the shipped default. Per-request `effort` overrides it.
_comment_keep_awake: Opt-in, macOS only. true = hold an idle-sleep assertion (built-in caffeinate) for as long as the bridge runs, so the Mac stays online; the Mac will NOT idle-sleep while the daemon is up (mind battery/heat on a laptop). Default false.
